realReviews.author: Jo Lovell
realReviews.text: HIGHLY RECOMMEND I recently purchased a door from Bunnings and arranged to have it hung through them. Atlas Carpentry arrived on time and did a beautiful job, they also fixed a number of issues I had after an experience with a very dodgy painter who left me with doors that would not close or lock. I will definitely use there service again. Pleasant professional and price friendly. Thanks for a great job.

realReviews.author: Eboni Monro
realReviews.text:
Having dealt with dodgy trades and spent 10 years in the real estate industry, I can confidently say after just one encounter with Andy—that he’s the right person for the job. Stop scrolling through Google reviews and just make the call or send the email!

His knowledge and old-school trade acumen are second to none. He knows his stuff.

realReviews.author: Adam Murphy
realReviews.text: Fantastic service. I had some really niche carpentry problems and Atlas had no trouble in finding a solution. They knew exactly how to fix it and the finish is fantastic! Thank you!
